scheme.name: Ganga Swarupa Pension Scheme
scheme.summary: The scheme provides monthly financial assistance to widowed women in Gujarat to help them achieve self-reliance and dignity.
eligibility: Applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
Applicant must be a widowed woman.
Applicant must be aged 18 years or above.
Annual income must not exceed ₹1,20,000 in rural areas and ₹1,50,000 in urban areas.
scheme.benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,250/- deposited directly into Post Office accounts.
scheme.how_to_apply: Obtain the application form from Taluka Mamlatdar’s office, fill it out, attach required documents, and submit it back to the Taluka Mamlatdar for verification and approval.
